actors.freezeMechanism: Stop the exact App Service before ledger mutation and keep it stopped throughout PITR. Restart behind a temporary operator-IP access restriction only after the active database has its own SQL application lock.
actors.verification: Azure state is Stopped during original-DB mutation, PITR, restored-DB verification, and connection switch; access restrictions deny non-operator traffic after restricted restart.
actors.unfreezeMethod: Restore the exact captured access-restriction set after acceptance or rollback.

actors.freezeMechanism: Only guarded runners receive the short-lived lock token and DDL-capable database URL. The original database keeps its own SQL application lock; any PITR-restored database receives a distinct SQL application lock before verification, connection switch, or restart.
actors.verification: Dangerous-command scan passes, every protected write requires matching lock/target tokens, a second actor is blocked on each active database, and restored-database lock evidence is recorded through switch and restricted restart.
actors.unfreezeMethod: Destroy the lock token and remove DDL credential from the runner environment.

actors.freezeMechanism: Stopping the exact App Service also stops any in-process scheduler or WebJob on that app. Separately freeze and inventory any scheduler hosted outside that App Service.
actors.verification: Azure reports the exact App Service Stopped. Operator confirms the external scheduler inventory in the authorization artifact; unavailable WebJob inventory is a procedural residual risk.
actors.unfreezeMethod: Restore only jobs explicitly captured before the freeze.
